title: A pair shares most of its work
hook: One twiddle multiplication can contribute to two frequencies.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Binary masks, basic complex arithmetic for FFT, polynomial coefficients.
doesNotKnow: Combine even and odd Fourier subtransforms through one twiddle product and sum/difference butterflies.

misconception: Every Fourier output must separately sum every input from scratch.
objective: Combine even and odd Fourier subtransforms through one twiddle product and sum/difference butterflies.

claims.text: The even and odd subtransforms are reused at two output positions. One twiddle product is added for the first position and subtracted for its partner. The computed spectrum retains both contributions; changing the exponent sign would conjugate these real-input results.
